title: GitHub MCP heist — a public issue steers one broad PAT through private repos and back out through a public PR
note: Reconstruction of Invariant Labs' demo: one official GitHub MCP server on one PAT covering public and private repos. The agent's issue-triage session reads the malicious public issue (ukend0464/pacman#1), then private repo contents (the demo leaked 'Jupiter Star', relocation plans, salary), then publishes them in a pull request on the public repo (pacman#2).
